source_geometry.block_centroid_rule: mean 3D unit vector of all member island centroids, normalized back to longitude/latitude

graph.edge_rule: symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor graph over block spherical centroids
graph.k_rule: smallest integer k >= 1 that makes all 219 block nodes connected
graph.kernel_scale_rule: Hyndman-Fan type-7 median of positive selected-edge lengths

R2_generic_context.unit: block, inherited by every island in that block

R3_direct_source_context.occupied_sources: training-only pilot islands after a later frozen pilot response open
R3_direct_source_context.nearest_source: minimum great-circle km to occupied training source islands
R3_direct_source_context.multi_source_pressure: sum exp(-island_distance_km / frozen block-graph kernel_scale_km) across occupied training source islands
R3_direct_source_context.training_row_rule: exclude focal pilot island from occupied-source set
R3_direct_source_context.confirmatory_prediction_rule: use all frozen pilot islands only; no confirmatory occurrence value

C_graph_source_context.geometry: shortest path km on the frozen 219-block kNN graph
C_graph_source_context.occupied_sources: same training-only occupied pilot islands as R3; each occupied island contributes using the path distance from target block to its source block
C_graph_source_context.nearest_source: minimum frozen block-graph path km to an occupied source block
C_graph_source_context.multi_source_pressure: sum exp(-block_path_km / frozen block-graph kernel_scale_km) once per occupied pilot source island
C_graph_source_context.training_row_rule: exclude focal pilot island before source aggregation
C_graph_source_context.confirmatory_prediction_rule: use all frozen pilot islands only; no confirmatory occurrence value

design_separation.validation_units: fixed bioregion-by-10-degree block labels from v1.25
design_separation.source_operator: distinct response-independent kNN graph whose edges connect those block centroids
design_separation.reason: heldout blocks are labels rather than connected components of the source graph, so graph-path continuity is not structurally forced to be unreachable across validation boundaries

outputs.operator_json: block centroids, selected k, kernel scale, edges, all-pairs shortest-path-derived generic block context
outputs.receipt_json: exact fingerprints, graph audit, cross-split/cross-bioregion support and response boundary
outputs.island_generic_context_csv: ID, block_id and inherited R2 generic graph features for all 5592 islands

success_ceiling.next_action: commit the exact operator and R2 context, then freeze the contaminated-macro pilot species-universe/estimability protocol before any further Appendix 1 access
